item.title: SR 40 closures in Marion County for animal warning lights, digital traffic signs
item.description: The Florida Department of Transportation is installing several technical upgrades along a 34-mile segment of State Road 40, including flashing lights to warn drivers of animals, cameras to monitor real-time traffic, and digital traffic signs with messages about current conditions. item.title: AdventHealth Ocala denies woman’s slip-and-fall allegations
item.description: AdventHealth Ocala has denied a lawsuit filed by a woman who claims she was injured in a slip-and-fall outside of the hospital, saying the walkway where the alleged incident occurred is properly maintained and that the woman's "own negligence" contributed to any potential injuries. item.title: How many coffee shops does Marion County need?
item.description: "Seriously? I'm wishing the best of luck, of course, to all businesses opening in Marion County. But how many coffee shops do we need in the area? Especially when the cost for a simple cup of coffee is outrageous. I noticed one area with two drive-thru coffee shops next to one another, as well as three within a one-mile area, along with three car washes within the same one to two mile radius.
